scripts.build: npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend build
scripts.lint: npm run -w backend lint && npm run -w frontend lint
scripts.format: npm run -w backend format && npm run -w frontend lint -- --fix
scripts.test: npm run -w backend test && npm run -w backend test:e2e && npm run -w backend test:cov && npm run -w frontend --if-present test
scripts.dev: npm run -w backend start:dev & npm run -w frontend dev
